headline: Sameer Gupta Substantial Acquisition Disclosure in Apollo Pipes
sum: Sameer Gupta has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Pipes Limited. The filing triggers SEBI's post-acquisition disclosure obligation, signalling a significant shareholding threshold breach in the publicly-listed PVC pipes and fittings manufacturer.
detail: Sameer Gupta's filing under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code (2011) discloses a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Pipes Limited, a publicly-listed manufacturer of PVC pipes, fittings, and related products. The regulation mandates disclosure once an acquirer's shareholding crosses prescribed thresholds; the precise shareholding percentage, acquisition price, and mode (open market / off-market / share purchase agreement) are embedded in the filed disclosure document. No corroborating press release or BSE announcement by Apollo Pipes or the acquirer was located in public sources as of 19 June 2026, suggesting either an embargo period or a non-mandatory public statement.
